fields.name: admin_token
fields.help: Circle Admin API v2 token (community Settings > Developers > Tokens, type Admin V2; Business plan or above) sent as Authorization: Bearer per the Admin API quick start (the Swagger spec documents the same header as 'Token <token>').

adapter.terms: Admin API calls count against a monthly plan quota (Business 5,000; Enterprise and Circle Plus 30,000; Circle Plus Platform 250,000 requests/month) and a rate limit of 2,000 requests per 5 minutes per IP (429 → back off).

me.note: GET /api/admin/v2/community returns the community the token belongs to: {id, name, slug, locale, created_at, is_private, community_setting{...}, ...}.

list_sales.note: GET /api/admin/v2/community_member_charges?page&per_page (max 100)&paywall_ids=product_id&created_at_gte=since (ISO 8601), newest first (default sort created_at desc): {page, per_page, has_next_page, count, page_count, records[{id, processor_id, status (paid|refunded|partial_refunded|...), refundable, amount, amount_refunded, currency, platform, payment_method_type, created_at, paywall_id, paywall_name, paywall_price_type, community_member_id, community_member_name, community_member_email}]}. `amount` is an INTEGER in currency subunits (1000 = 10.00 USD). `refunded` is not a boolean field (see status / raw.amount_refunded).

list_refunds.note: Circle has no separate refund object: this lists the charges with status refunded or partial_refunded (GET /api/admin/v2/community_member_charges?status=refunded,partial_refunded&page&per_page&created_at_gte=since, newest first). `id`/`sale_id` are the charge id, `amount` is amount_refunded (INTEGER in currency subunits) and `created_at` is the charge date, not the refund date; no reason is returned.

refund.note: DESTRUCTIVE: POST /api/admin/v2/community_member_charges/{id}/refund {amount, reason_details} refunds the charge in FULL when `amount` is omitted, or partially by `amount`, which is sent as an INTEGER in currency subunits (200 = 2.00 USD). `reason` is REQUIRED by Circle (reason_details, max 255 chars; missing → 422 upstream_error). Returns the updated charge: `amount` is amount_refunded and `status` becomes refunded or partial_refunded.

not_offered.list_products: Admin API v2 exposes paywalls only as DELETE /api/admin/v2/paywalls/{id} (plus paywall groups, coupons and affiliates); there is no endpoint that lists paywalls — they are managed in the community's Paywalls settings UI.
not_offered.get_product: No GET /api/admin/v2/paywalls/{id}: the only paywall operation is DELETE, so a paywall cannot be read through the API (paywall_id / paywall_name appear on charge and subscription rows).
not_offered.create_product: No paywall creation endpoint in Admin API v2 (only DELETE /api/admin/v2/paywalls/{id}); paywalls and their prices are created in the community settings UI.
not_offered.update_price: Paywall prices (paywall_price_id, paywall_price_type, paywall_price_interval on charge rows) have no create/update endpoint in Admin API v2.
not_offered.get_sales_stats: No revenue-totals endpoint: POST /api/admin/v2/community_member_charges/export creates a background CSV export that is e-mailed to the admin, which the runtime cannot map; totals must be summed from list_sales rows.

evidence: host app.circle.so: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Sectigo Limited)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://api-headless.circle.so/api/admin/v2/swagger.yaml: 4/4 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
